mapper.insert: INSERT INTO previsit_report_content ( report_id, customer_id, customer_name, rm_name, visit_objective, customer_overview, kyc_gap_summary, product_schemes, key_questions, risk_reminders, visit_strategy, journey_id, operating_case_id ) VALUES ( #{content.reportId}, #{content.customerId}, #{content.customerName}, #{content.rmName}, #{content.visitObjective}, #{content.customerOverview, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.JsonTypeHandler}, #{content.kycGapSummary, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.JsonTypeHandler}, #{content.productSchemes, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.ProductSchemeListTypeHandler}, #{content.keyQuestions, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{content.riskReminders, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{content.visitStrategy}, #{journeyId}, #{operatingCaseId} )
mapper.select: SELECT report_id, customer_id, customer_name, rm_name, visit_objective, customer_overview, kyc_gap_summary, product_schemes, key_questions, risk_reminders, visit_strategy FROM previsit_report_content WHERE report_id = #{reportId}

SELECT report_id, customer_id, customer_name, rm_name, visit_objective, customer_overview, kyc_gap_summary, product_schemes, key_questions, risk_reminders, visit_strategy FROM previsit_report_content WHERE operating_case_id = #{operatingCaseId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT report_id, customer_id, customer_name, rm_name, visit_objective, customer_overview, kyc_gap_summary, product_schemes, key_questions, risk_reminders, visit_strategy FROM previsit_report_content WHERE journey_id = #{journeyId}
